Use case: stylized-concept. Production concept sheet for a cozy Genshin-like painted browser RPG, landscape 1600x1100 composition. Warm ivory paper, restrained gold rules, crisp large readable labels, generous spacing. Painted warm wood #9b6f3e with dark #664930 supports, brass #B58C47 and copper fittings, honey limestone #DEC398, lavender shadows, small muted teal accents. Warm upper-left light. Broad surfaces, beveled boxes, 6-sided cylinders and swept tubes, no intricate tiny gears. Main objects all seen from above at the game's 35 degree downward three-quarter camera. One block = one metre; include a 1.8m hero scale silhouette. Every part gets a clearly outlined block-grid footprint and neighbor connection inset plus THREE small illustrated states WORKING / STARVED / BACKED UP, use physical motion, empty input, and piled goods respectively, not just colored status dots. Passive parts show contextual empty/occupied states explicitly. Standard shaft is at y=.5 and ends flush at grid-cell boundaries, hex copper socket with brass collar. Goods chutes open mouths at cell edges. Short power slows movement, never means broken; no fuel, wear, repairs or danger spikes. Keep silhouette readable at game distance. This is a buildable engineering reference, not an ornate fantasy painting.
Title HANDS. Six clearly separated rows, left main perspective, center footprint/join diagrams, right three contextual state miniatures. DITCH 1x1 tile .25 deep, open ends join flat or downhill; wet flowing / dry / ponded at blocked end. LAMP 1x1 wood post 1.7 high, brass hanging wax lantern, simple manual shutter; lit / commanded off (no fuel depletion) / lit but creature route obstructed. WORKBENCH 2x1, .8 counter 1.4 tool board, existing plank table with vise hammer saw; crafting / no input goods / output tray full. FENCE 1-block edge module .9 high with two chunky rails, posts join at corners; guides gearling / empty route / queued gearlings. PIT 1x1 one block below ground, dark open earth/stone-lined cell, open exit side ramp inset and adjacent pusher join; spring drops under paused harmless gearling / empty / occupied with queue outside. HATCH ROOF 1x1 at y=2, wood louver leaf with copper hinge shaft edge; open admits sun onto sleeping rootsnare / closed shade / obstructed swing shown as dashed clearance, proposed state. Bottom swatches wood brass copper limestone and full hero scale.

Title WATER POWER. Five rows. WATERWHEEL show TWO equal-sized versions: 2x1 footprint, 1.8 diameter vertical wooden paddle wheel, brass hub on low bearings; undershot flat flowing stream labeled 4 POWER, overshot one-block falling water labeled 6 POWER, environment water separate. Axle outlet to adjacent .5-high shaft. States turning / dry inlet / load exceeds output, still turning slowly. GEAR SHAFT three equal prominence variants each 1x1: straight flush endpoints, corner bevel gearbox at 90 degrees, slope rise 1 over run 1 via universal joints; each socket y .5 relative to own terrain, dotted rotation arrows. States full rotation / disconnected supply / overloaded slow rotation. LEVER 1x1 short timber base copper handle on shaft clutch, engaged / disengaged / downstream load with slower engaged shaft, no individual-only switching: switches EVERY part on shaft. SPRINKLER 1x1 height .7 brass four-nozzle standpipe, side hex shaft socket drives pumping, frog-slick gasket; water spray / dry inlet or no drive / low-power shorter sparse spray (proposed look, coverage stays same). Show exact 3x3 footprint inset: center sprinkler, shaft occupies one neighbor so eight surrounding blocks wet but only seven crop spots in ring if shaft occupies ring; source says eight wet not nine. Do not draw sprinkler irrigating itself. Bottom legend power 4 asked for 6 = 2/3 speed to all; standard socket exploded inset.

Show five detected subject icons creature / loose good / light / dry soil / ripe crop; do not invent exact detection range. Large 3/4 view and front side inset with 1m grid. WORKING eye open and brass vane up / STARVED no matching subject eye dim and vane down / BACKED UP sees full chest, vane closes shaft clutch, contextual automatic shutoff. Show small assembly of collector chest with sensor beside it and lamp overhead OUTSIDE WATER: dry lanternfly dust trap; full chest turns lamp OFF, identical dimmed result state. Clear arrows sensor -> shared shaft -> all attached parts, a lever override inset. On/off are commands, not fuel exhaustion. Show lamp back and top views, materials, hero scale. Do not suggest sensor is a power generator.

Title FOUR FARMS / Give layouts. Four generous equal panels 2x2, actual high game camera 35-degree down, painted diorama terrain with subtle one-metre grid and minimal numbered route arrows, no UI. Consistent modular warm wood brass/copper simple parts. Panel 1 GEARLING PIT: wheel in flowing stream powers shafts to running lure machine within 16 blocks, fence corridor turns small friendly brass gearlings into UNLIT one-block-deep pit with shaded interior; adjacent powered pusher moves stopped gearling sideways out via ramp into open return path, harmless spring left in pit collected by chest within 3, no killing, no lamp lighting pit, no queue except tiny failure inset. Panel 3 TERRACE DAY: 6-power wheel under falling water in ditch below, connected copper shafts climb slope through corner joints to TWO sprinklers on separate upper terraces each uses 1, crops on wet soil around sprinklers, each sprinkler's immediate 3x3 ring highlighted, SHAFT and SPRINKLER occupy separate crop-free blocks, restful flower row one in four and one bee box beside field; source ditch flows only flat/downhill, mechanical shaft sends power uphill, no water climbing ditch; inset 4-power flat wheel alternative. Panel 4 LAMP POND DUSK: three lamps in line across shallow pond progressively brighter toward right, broad numbered halos 1 dim / 2 medium / 3 bright, lanternflies travel toward brightest within 12 blocks, frogs on stones within 3 blocks of flight line eat flies, slick drops by frogs, collector chest on bank within 3; pond remains open no nets. Each panel show one small diagnostic vignette for starved and backed-up condition with short captions, route legend for power vs goods vs creatures. Include 1.8m hero at common scale.
